```{python}
#| echo: false
from _common import *
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
```

[Icechunk](https://icechunk.io) is a transactional storage engine for
Zarr. GDAL reads Icechunk repositories through `/vsiicechunk/` when
built with it, which most packaged builds are not yet. This page runs
only where the build has it; the store status below says whether it did
this time.

```{python}
"/vsiicechunk/" in gdal.GetFileSystemsPrefixes()
```

## ECMWF AIFS forecasts

ECMWF's AI forecast system, published by dynamical.org as an Icechunk
repository on anonymous S3 (CC-BY-4.0). New initialisation times are
appended as they are produced.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
status_callout("aifs-icechunk")
```

```{python}
#| error: true
dsn = "/vsis3/dynamical-ecmwf-aifs-single/ecmwf-aifs-single-forecast/v0.1.0.icechunk"
cfg = {"AWS_NO_SIGN_REQUEST": "YES", "AWS_REGION": "us-west-2"}
if live("aifs-icechunk"):
    aifs = xr.open_dataset(dsn, engine="gdalxarray", config_options=cfg)
    print(list(aifs.data_vars)[:8], dict(aifs.sizes))
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
assert dsn == store("aifs-icechunk")["dsn"]
```

The 10 m wind at Hobart through the first forecast:

```{python}
#| error: true
#| fig-cap: "AIFS 10 m wind components at Hobart for the first initialisation in the store."
if live("aifs-icechunk"):
    pt = dict(latitude=-42.9, longitude=147.3, method="nearest")
    u = aifs["wind_u_10m"].isel(init_time=0).sel(**pt)
    v = aifs["wind_v_10m"].isel(init_time=0).sel(**pt)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 3.2))
    u.plot(ax=ax, label="u"); v.plot(ax=ax, label="v"); ax.legend()
    plt.show()
```

A single 2D face of the 4D array, as a classic raster any GDAL tool can
use: `:{0}:{0}` fixes `init_time` and `lead_time`.

```{python}
#| error: true
if live("aifs-icechunk"):
    face = xr.open_dataset(
        'ZARR:"/vsiicechunk/{/vsis3/dynamical-ecmwf-aifs-single/'
        'ecmwf-aifs-single-forecast/v0.1.0.icechunk}":/wind_u_10m:{0}:{0}',
        engine="gdalxarray", multidim=False, config_options=cfg)
    print(face["band_data"].shape)
```

## ERA5, partly readable

Earthmover's ERA5 Icechunk repository opens, and its coordinates read,
but its data variables use the `pcodec` codec, which GDAL does not
decode yet. The read below shows the error GDAL gives; when GDAL gains
the codec, this cell starts producing values with no change here.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
status_callout("era5-icechunk")
```

```{python}
#| error: true
dsn = "/vsiicechunk/{/vsis3/earthmover-icechunk-era5/icechunkV2}/pressure/spatial"
if live("era5-icechunk"):
    era5 = xr.open_dataset(dsn, engine="gdalxarray",
                           config_options={"AWS_NO_SIGN_REQUEST": "YES", "AWS_REGION": "us-east-1"})
    print(dict(era5.sizes))
    var = list(era5.data_vars)[0]
    try:
        era5[var].isel({d: 0 for d in era5[var].dims}).values
    except Exception as e:
        print(type(e).__name__, str(e).splitlines()[0])
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
assert dsn == store("era5-icechunk")["dsn"]
```
